description: Fires on the move that completes a named trap's setup (step_label='setup_completed'). E.g. m4 Ng5 in the Italian Game completes the Fried Liver setup. The {trap_description} comes from data/traps.json — adding a new trap = adding a JSON entry there, no edits here.

fact_glossary.trap_name: Authored trap name from data/traps.json (e.g. 'Fried Liver Attack')
